name: storeware-packages
description: The Storeware CLI, SDK, App Bridge for React and App UI, as they are released.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter ./packages/plugin-sdk build:dist && pnpm --filter ./packages/app-ui build:dist && pnpm --filter ./packages/app-bridge-react build:dist && pnpm --filter ./packages/cli build:dist
scripts.test: pnpm --filter ./packages/plugin-sdk test && pnpm --filter ./packages/app-ui test && pnpm --filter ./packages/app-bridge-react test && pnpm --filter ./packages/cli test
scripts.typecheck: pnpm --filter ./packages/plugin-sdk typecheck && pnpm --filter ./packages/app-ui typecheck && pnpm --filter ./packages/app-bridge-react typecheck && pnpm --filter ./packages/cli typecheck
